muc.title: Which video should I watch first?
muc.text: This is Mark, and Bit the robot. Mark wonders: the channel is close to a hundred videos, so which one should a newcomer watch first? Bit answers: let's open the map. The whole channel has just seven regions.

muc.title: Getting started
muc.text: Region one, getting started: AI is really guessing words, why it makes things up, why it forgets. If you're brand new, start here.

muc.title: Using AI every day
muc.text: Region two, using AI every day: writing prompts, building your own assistant, and the Claude toolbox.

muc.title: Inside AI, and measuring it
muc.text: Region three, inside AI: tokens, attention, and how AI learns from its own mistakes. Region four: how AI gets graded, and its senses for listening, talking and seeing.

muc.title: Systems and work
muc.text: Region five, the systems behind it: tool calling, MCP, multi-agent, guardrails, monitoring. Region six, AI and work: which jobs change, and how AI products are made.

muc.title: Learning with AI
muc.text: Region seven, learning with AI: a private tutor, learning through simulation, and interactive learning where AI asks you questions back.

muc.title: No need to go in order
muc.text: You don't need to watch in number order. Pick the region you need most, watch part one of that series, then keep going.

muc.title: Find your region
muc.text: Write down one thing you want AI to help with this week, then find the region on the map that covers it. The full list is in the pinned comment.
